description_en: We have business premises for sale in Selite. The facilities are located in the new complex that is being built in the Selite area. The facility is also located in a developed area, from a social-cultural point of view. The building is organized in 7 floors (6 residential and 1 premises) and -2 floors of land. The building will be covered, which is a good solution for thermal and acoustic insulation. The project is among the most beautiful in terms of architectural design and of absolute quality. To visit it, contact us!
